acceptable_visual_variants: The flag flying high on a flagpole against a clear blue sky
The flag being held or waved during a patriotic celebration
cultural_entities.gloss: The Indian national flag, literally meaning 'three-colored' or 'tricolor'.
negative_confusions: A generic three-colored flag without the specific saffron, white, and green bands or the central wheel
The flag of another country that happens to have three colors
visual_features: A horizontal rectangular tricolor flag with saffron at the top, white in the middle, and green at the bottom.
A navy blue wheel (Ashoka Chakra) with 24 spokes in the center of the white band.

annotation.emotional_arc: A single, sustained burst of patriotic pride and celebration.

metaphor_spans.abstract_meaning: The desire for the nation's pride, sovereignty, and honor to remain elevated and undefeated in the world.
acceptable_visual_variants: A close-up of the tricolor flag waving dynamically against a clear blue sky
A wide shot of the flag flying atop a prominent national monument or mast under a bright sun
metaphor_spans.literal_meaning: May our flag physically fly at a high altitude
metaphor_spans.literalization_risk: An illustrator might depict only a physical piece of cloth on a tall pole without capturing the abstract sense of national pride and collective aspiration.
metaphor_spans.source_span_translation: May our flag fly high forever
metaphor_spans.visualization_strategy: Depict a vibrant tricolor flag fluttering proudly and high in the sky against a bright, hopeful dawn, possibly with a crowd of diverse people looking up at it with respect.

translation_loss.what_was_lost: The translation adds the word 'forever' which is not explicitly present in the original Hindi text, altering the rhythmic and semantic focus of the second line.
The specific grammatical structure and internal rhyme of 'pyara' (beloved) and 'hamara' (ours) are lost in the English rendering.

annotation.theme: Patriotic pride and devotion to the national flag as a symbol of victory.

consistency_review_findings.issue: The translation_quality is marked as 'faithful', but the stanza contains non-empty translation_loss items detailing semantic additions and lost grammatical/rhyme structures. This is internally inconsistent.

original_poem:
विजयी विश्व तिरंगा प्यारा,  
झंडा ऊँचा रहे हमारा।
translated_poem:
Our triumphant tricolor beloved,  
May our flag fly high forever.
